description: See which port each worktree's dev server is on, and open it in one click. The app port leads as a named pill; database, Docker, and internal listeners fold behind a toggle so nothing is hunted for. Hover a pill to stop the process or container holding it. The same listing answers `bb ports list` and the worktree_ports agent tool, so an agent can name the URL instead of guessing. Needs lsof, so macOS or Linux only; Docker ports need the docker CLI.
